answer: Forging a thousand identities requires a thousand bonds, and colluding peers risk slashing their own stake like a reef breaking waves. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot anchoring: each new agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, verified through a prism of cross-signed attestations from existing peers. Reputation decays unless renewed, so dormant fakes wither like a willow in drought, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0011 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
